title: 20-Minute Mobility Routine

exercises.name: Cat-Cow
exercises.description: Arch and round your back slowly, breathing through each movement.

exercises.name: Thread the Needle
exercises.description: From all-fours, slide one arm under your body and rotate to stretch upper back.

exercises.name: Hip Circles
exercises.description: Rotate hips in large circles while keeping torso stable.

exercises.name: Deep Squat Hold
exercises.description: Sit into a deep squat, chest up, gently rock side to side.

exercises.name: Banded Shoulder Dislocates
exercises.description: Hold a band wide with both hands, raise it overhead and back behind you, keeping arms straight throughout.

exercises.name: World's Greatest Stretch
exercises.description: From a deep lunge, rotate your torso and reach one arm to the sky to open hips and upper back.

exercises.name: Arm Circles
exercises.description: Make large controlled circles with straight arms, forward then reverse, to warm up the shoulders.

exercises.name: Ankle Circles
exercises.description: Lift one foot and rotate the ankle through its full range in each direction.

exercises.name: Leg Swings (Front-to-Back)
exercises.description: Holding a support, swing one leg forward and back with a relaxed, growing range.

exercises.name: Leg Swings (Side-to-Side)
exercises.description: Holding a support, swing one leg across your body and back out to open the hip.

exercises.name: Standing Torso Twists
exercises.description: Rotate your upper body side to side with loose arms to warm up the spine.

exercises.name: Inchworm to Plank
exercises.description: Hinge over, walk your hands out to a plank, pause, then walk your feet back in to your hands.

exercises.name: Wrist Circles & Stretch
exercises.description: Rotate each wrist through its full range, then gently press the palm back to stretch the forearm.

exercises.name: Scapular Push-Ups
exercises.description: In plank, protract and retract shoulder blades without bending arms.

exercises.name: Push-Ups
exercises.description: Perform 8-15 controlled reps, keeping your body in a straight line from head to heels.

exercises.name: Y-T-W Raises
exercises.description: Lift arms into Y, T, and W shapes slowly to activate upper back.

exercises.name: B-Stance Glute Bridge
exercises.description: One foot forward, lift hips using mainly the back leg’s glute.

exercises.name: Banded Glute Bridge
exercises.description: Loop a band above your knees, drive hips up while pressing knees outward against the band.

exercises.name: Band Pull-Aparts
exercises.description: Hold a resistance band at shoulder width and pull it apart, squeezing shoulder blades together for 12-15 reps.

exercises.name: Banded Y-Raises
exercises.description: Anchor a band low, raise both arms overhead into a Y shape against the resistance.

exercises.name: Banded Face Pulls
exercises.description: Anchor a band at chest height, pull toward your face with elbows high, squeezing shoulder blades together.

exercises.name: Banded Rows
exercises.description: Anchor a band in front of you, row both hands to your ribs, squeezing shoulder blades together.

exercises.name: Banded External Rotations
exercises.description: Elbow pinned to your side, rotate your forearm outward against band resistance to strengthen the rotator cuff.

exercises.name: Plank Hold
exercises.description: Hold a forearm plank for 30-45 seconds, keeping hips level and core braced.

exercises.name: Dead Bugs
exercises.description: Lower opposite arm and leg while keeping lower back pressed down.

exercises.name: Bird Dog
exercises.description: From all-fours, extend one arm and the opposite leg while keeping hips level and core braced.

exercises.name: Superman Hold
exercises.description: Lie face down and lift your arms, chest, and legs off the floor, holding briefly at the top.

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.description: Prop up on one forearm and lift your hips into a straight line, holding each side.

exercises.name: Wall Slides
exercises.description: Back flat against a wall, slide your arms up and down while keeping contact with the wall.

exercises.name: Reverse Snow Angels
exercises.description: Lying face down, sweep your arms overhead and back like a snow angel, squeezing shoulder blades.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
exercises.description: Drive one heel down to lift your hips while the other leg stays extended out straight.

exercises.name: Knee-Over-Toe Split Squat
exercises.description: Front knee travels forward over toes while keeping heel down.

exercises.name: 90/90 Transitions
exercises.description: Rotate knees side to side while keeping feet grounded.

exercises.name: Russian Twists
exercises.description: Rotate torso side to side, tapping the floor each side for 12-16 total reps.

exercises.name: Halos
exercises.description: Circle a light weight or band around your head, reversing direction halfway through.

exercises.name: Banded Lateral Walks
exercises.description: Loop a band above your knees and take side steps, keeping tension on the band and hips level.

exercises.name: Banded Clamshells
exercises.description: Loop a band above your knees, lie on your side and open your top knee against the resistance.

exercises.name: Banded Good Mornings
exercises.description: Stand on a band, hinge at the hips keeping a flat back, feeling tension build through your hamstrings.

exercises.name: Hamstring Sweep
exercises.description: Hinge forward and reach toward foot to stretch hamstrings.

exercises.name: Lat Stretch
exercises.description: Hold onto a surface, sink hips back, lightly pull against the stretch.

exercises.name: Cossack Squat
exercises.description: Shift side to side into a deep lateral squat, keeping the straight leg's heel down.

exercises.name: Frog Stretch
exercises.description: Knees wide on all-fours, rock your hips back and forward to open the inner thighs.

exercises.name: Pigeon Pose
exercises.description: Front shin angled forward on the floor, sink your hips down to stretch the glute and hip.

exercises.name: Couch Stretch
exercises.description: Rear foot propped up behind you, drive your hips forward to stretch the quad and hip flexor.

exercises.name: Spiderman Lunge with Rotation
exercises.description: Step into a deep lunge, plant both hands down, and rotate one arm toward the sky.

exercises.name: Box Breathing
exercises.description: Inhale 4 sec, hold 4 sec, exhale 4 sec, hold 4 sec.

exercises.name: Pec Stretch
exercises.description: Forearm on doorway, step forward until chest opens.

exercises.name: Banded Hamstring Stretch
exercises.description: Loop a band around one foot and gently pull the leg straight toward you to deepen the hamstring stretch.

exercises.name: Banded Hip Flexor Stretch
exercises.description: Loop a band low around your hip, step forward and gently shift your weight to deepen the hip flexor stretch.

exercises.name: Child's Pose Reach
exercises.description: Sit back on heels, reach arms to one side to stretch lats and ribs.

exercises.name: Neck CARs
exercises.description: Slow, controlled circles with your head exploring full range.

exercises.name: Downward Dog
exercises.description: Hips lifted high, heels reaching toward the floor, arms and back long.

exercises.name: Figure-4 Stretch
exercises.description: Lying down, cross one ankle over the opposite knee and pull the far thigh in to stretch the glute.

exercises.name: Cobra Stretch
exercises.description: Lying face down, press your chest up while keeping hips down to extend the spine.

exercises.name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
exercises.description: Pull one arm across your chest, holding just above the elbow, to stretch the rear shoulder.

exercises.name: Supine Spinal Twist
exercises.description: Lying on your back, drop both knees to one side while keeping shoulders flat on the floor.

exercises.name: Legs-Up-The-Wall
exercises.description: Lie on your back with legs resting up a wall and breathe slowly to help the body downshift.

footer: Rotate these routines throughout the week! Focus on mobility, stability, and recovery.
